description: Delete a saved conversion goal. Applying deactivates it and hides its definition from lists and analytics reads. Preview returns the goal; no restore tool is exposed.

outputSchema.description: message describes the outcome. preview and confirmationRequired identify a review without writing; current and updates show proposed edits when present. goal contains its name, conversion type/target, filters and historical-data policy; saved results also include ID, activation and update time; success confirms an applied mutation.
